study.question: Does offdiagonal covariance within each retrieved semantic field improve current-ad-conditioned history values beyond the existing diagonal dispersion branch? Observed starting point: static/pooled/DIN validation AUC=0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. Separate target reads reached 0.6153351064; aligned target products reached 0.6162637997. The latest variance_target is 0.6165873542 versus mean_square_target 0.6164331394, variance_context 0.6162324051 and mean_square_context 0.6165090898. Thus the variance-versus-mean effect is +0.0001542148 for target and -0.0002766848 for context, factorial difference +0.0004308996; this is a small one-seed observation, not repeated mechanism support. Incumbent code keeps only coordinate variances, discarding their offdiagonal dependence at its added branch. Is that restriction consequential?
study.hypothesis: Provisional mechanism: attended event deviations contain within-field coordinate co-fluctuation that a target direction can read usefully. For field f, C_f=sum_l w_fl (x_fl-h_f)(x_fl-h_f)^T and q_f is either the current-ad embedding or the masked uniform history mean. Replace sum_f q_f^2 * diag(C_f) with sum_f q_f * (C_f q_f), then use exactly the inherited driver normalization, learned moment map and summary normalization. The full statistic includes the same diagonal terms plus offdiagonal terms. Compute Cq through weighted centered-event contractions in O(BLD), without an explicit covariance tensor in forward. Keep the 256-parameter moment map already present in round 9; this is a statistic replacement, not added capacity. A positive full-versus-diagonal contrast with target operands and a positive target/context interaction would provisionally support useful target-specific covariance structure. Wider literature priority is unverified; no novelty or source-faithful reproduction claim is made.

nearest_work.difference: Direct parent. Retain architecture, two existing residual maps and all initialization; replace q^2*diag(C) with q*(Cq). Diagonal target and context cells retain the inherited forward operations and act as replay controls. No offdiagonal category-brand terms.

study.proposed_difference: Four-cell replacement experiment: covariance_target (candidate), diagonal_target (incumbent replay), covariance_context and diagonal_context (round-9 context replay). The single new model flag covariance_values selects full q*(Cq) versus q^2*diag(C); moment_target selects only the operand source. All cells retain moment_variance=true, target_query=true, separate_reads=true, value_target=true and product_values=true. Within forward, _state computes centered category/brand deviations with inherited attention. _covariance_raw contracts weighted deviations and their query dot products. _moment_driver substitutes that statistic before the inherited normalization. Each standalone module differs only in literal CONFIG defaults and declares the same API. Expected total/dense parameters=17,130,787/52,099 for every cell. Constructor AST matches the incumbent after removing only the new boolean attribute assignment. 41 bounded diagnostics check explicit-versus-contracted covariance, diagonal agreement, quadratic-form nonnegativity, offdiagonal norm, signed coordinates, driver degeneracy, attention padding, empty/singleton behavior, norm control, frozen-checkpoint branch/statistic/source switches and sample counts. Diagnostics on 512 impressions cannot establish AUC gains or causal mechanism. Source-only reproduction: python3 -m py_compile covariance_target.py diagonal_target.py covariance_context.py diagonal_context.py. Host reproduction: submit proposal.json through the existing automatic runner; instantiate each listed Model(meta, config) under the frozen protocol. No separate public training command is exposed, so none is invented. Completed local checks: prospective-study schema and allowed observation IDs validated against the resolved runtime, registered configs checked against literal module CONFIG dictionaries, import/access scan and compilation passed, 41 diagnostics verified, and cross-cell AST equivalence confirmed after CONFIG removal. Independent scalar Python algebra checks passed for event-contraction versus explicit covariance, diagonal restriction, singleton and zero-weight histories, and nonnegative quadratic-form sum. A discriminating toy pair [(2,2),(0,0)] versus [(2,0),(0,2)] at uniform weights shares mean (1,1) and diagonal variance (1,1); operand q=(1,2) gives the same diagonal driver (1,4) but full drivers (3,6) and (-1,2), also differing after normalization. This is mathematical/source validation only, not Torch numerical execution or predictive evidence. Preparation/check costs belong to the declared ledger. Append-only interpretation for subsequent host receipt linkage: round-9 dispersion specificity remains provisional, its context reversal and small margins are retained, and full covariance is an untested hypothesis. No prior record or human knowledge was overwritten.
predictions: Primary prospective contrast Delta_T=AUC(covariance_target)-AUC(diagonal_target)>0. A screening gain of at least 0.0001 warrants paired-seed follow-up; it is a practical scheduling threshold, not significance.

Specificity contrast I=Delta_T-[AUC(covariance_context)-AUC(diagonal_context)]>0. Positive Delta_T without positive I supports an operational covariance benefit but not added current-ad specificity. Compare Logloss independently; do not hide disagreement.

Source algebra predicts full raw summed coordinates=sum_f q_f^T C_f q_f>=0 up to floating point error, though individual coordinates may be negative. Empty/singleton covariances vanish; padding gets zero attention mass; summary norm stays matched. Full contraction must agree with explicit covariance in diagnostics to floating point tolerance.

Predeclared exploratory slices use the existing fixed host bins for history length, hour, action composition, frequency and category-match presence, with supplied sample/positive/negative counts and insufficient-slice marks. No new validation-derived bins. History_gt64 dominates the incumbent sample count (3,026,583; 151,372 positives), so overall gains need not transfer to short histories.

Diagonal target/context should replay round-9 AUC 0.6165873541792734 / 0.6162324050617801 for matching seed/host execution; discrepancy is an implementation/reproducibility issue to investigate before attributing a gain. Empty-history predictions may differ across retrained cells due to shared learned parameters despite their zero covariance branch.
falsifiers: Delta_T<=0 fails the proposed practical advantage of this full-covariance implementation; preserve the result and do not call the budget expenditure success.
I<=0 fails additional target-operand specificity even if full covariance improves quality. A gain in both operands may reflect a general statistic or optimization effect.

Large covariance contraction error, nonzero empty/singleton raw statistics, padding attention, nonfinite values or broken summary norm contradict implementation fidelity. A replay mismatch requires diagnosis before scientific interpretation; all failed/retry costs stay charged.

No reproducible advantage across paired seeds 42/43/44, or a gain dominated by seed noise/user-cluster uncertainty, prevents repeated-support claims. If a public bootstrap interface is unavailable, state that uncertainty rather than inventing an interval.

No useful offdiagonal signal or near-identical normalized drivers weakens the discarded-covariance explanation. Nonzero branch sensitivity alone does not support predictive utility. A null here does not refute all covariance representations or the source methods.

Offdiagonal terms also allow signed coordinates and can change the degenerate-driver rate. This comparison identifies their joint operational effect, not a separate sign or conditioning mechanism.
Learned category and brand bases differ; covariance is computed only within each basis. There are no category-brand covariance terms and no assumption of aligned bases across fields.
Target/context refers only to the added moment operand: retrieval and the inherited first-moment product residual remain target-conditioned in every cell.
